session.instructions:
An original young adult Japanese female voice around age nineteen, speaking native standard Japanese. High-pitched, crystal-bright, refreshingly clear girlish soprano with open, ringing bell-like resonance and transparent, unclouded purity — zero breathy veil, zero nasal murkiness, and zero sticky sugariness. Crisp, luminous forward projection, light youthful vocal weight, and natural, sunlit smiling clarity.
Speak immediately in Japanese. Say exactly this line once: "おはようございます、坂口先生。今朝もすごくいいお天気ですね。今日も一緒に頑張りましょうね。". Do not translate, paraphrase, repeat, or add words. Then remain silent. Delivery direction: High-pitched, crystal-clear, brightly ringing girlish soprano voice — open, transparent, crisp, and sunlit with natural fluid pacing at strong close-mic studio volume, completely free of breathiness or muffling. No music or background noise.
